answer: Require every new agent to stake a refundable deposit that vests slowly, like water seeping through karst: a flood of fake identities cannot pass because each one must lock real funds for weeks, and the cost multiplies with every clone. Honest agents earn the stake back plus fees from a shared oasis of verified work, while a garden of long-lived reputations, built only through attested transactions, lets peers tell a rooted participant from a freshly planted fake. Sybils pay per identity; real agents pay once.
